description:
Capterra reviews of a product (pros, cons, sub-ratings, reviewer role and company
        size), filterable by stars, language and date, most helpful or newest first.

        Cost: 1 credit per call, up to 25 reviews; the next page is a new call with `cursor`.
        A call with no reviews but a `next_cursor` is free. Reviewers are anonymous.

        Args:
            product_id: Capterra id, e.g. '135003'.
            sort: 'helpful' (default) or 'recent'.
            stars: Ratings to keep, e.g. [1, 2].
            language: ISO 639-1 code ('en').
            since: Published on/after, 'YYYY-MM-DD'.
            until: Published on/before, 'YYYY-MM-DD'.
            limit: Reviews to return, 1-25.
            cursor: `next_cursor` of the previous call (same filters).
name: capterra_get_reviews
title: Get Capterra reviews
